title: fix(setup)!: serve the Audit Log entry to a view_all_audit_log holder who lacks manage_platform_settings
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXuamRUC67fx2TTYrFfyuSH)_

Part of #33224 — this PR lands the navigation half (the Audit Log entry reaches the auditor). The Setup landing half (Packaged Actions answering `activation ledger HTTP 403`) stays open on the card; the seat ruled route A (below), and it follows in its own PR.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `GET /meta/app/setup` now serves `group_diagnostics` with the Audit Log entry (`nav_audit_logs`) to a member who holds `view_all_audit_log` without `manage_platform_settings`; before, the whole group was withheld from them. Every shipped permission set is served what it was before: `admin_full_access` holds both capabilities and still sees Sessions, Notification Events and Audit Log; `organization_admin` and the member sets hold neither and still see no Diagnostics group. One custom-set audience narrows: a set granting `manage_platform_settings` without `view_all_audit_log` is no longer served the Audit Log entry. A gate is all-of, so the entry cannot be gated on either capability.
Metadata-protocol: none

**BREAKING** for a custom permission set that grants `manage_platform_settings` without `view_all_audit_log`. Its holders were served the Setup › Diagnostics › Audit Log entry and no longer are. The Audit Log page itself is unchanged: it still opens by URL and still shows them the organization-attributed ledger rows it showed before. What to do: grant `view_all_audit_log` to that set if its holders should keep the menu entry, or open the page by URL. A third-party package that contributes an entry into `group_diagnostics` without its own `requiredPermissions` is now shown to every member who can open Setup, where before only `manage_platform_settings` holders saw it: declare `requiredPermissions` on the entry (see below).

## Maintainer quick read

- What changes: Setup's Diagnostics group no longer requires `manage_platform_settings` for the whole group; each entry carries its own gate. Sessions and Notification Events still require `manage_platform_settings`; Audit Log now requires its own read capability, `view_all_audit_log`.
- Why: a group's gate prunes the whole group before any child is judged, so an auditor holding `view_all_audit_log` without platform-settings power (the auditor of a separation-of-duties setup) never saw the Audit Log entry in Setup and had to type the URL.
- Risk and rollback: declared narrowing (BREAKING for one custom-set audience). Shipped permission sets see the same menu as before (admins hold both capabilities; organization admins and members hold neither). The only audience that narrows is a custom set holding `manage_platform_settings` without `view_all_audit_log`: it no longer sees the Audit Log entry (the page still opens by URL). Rollback is a revert of this PR.
- Read first: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup.app.ts` (the removed group gate), `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts` (the entry's `requiredPermissions`), `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` (Sessions and Notification Events take the former group gate).
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/setup-diagnostics-audience.pin.test.ts`; expect 3 green cases: a `view_all_audit_log`-only holder sees only Audit Log under Diagnostics; a caller without it sees Audit Log nowhere in Setup; an admin still sees all three entries.
- Needed from you: nothing; the seat lands it.

## What changes

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup.app.ts` — `group_diagnostics` no longer carries `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']`. A group's gate prunes its whole subtree before any child is judged (`filterAppForUserWithReason` in `@objectstack/rest`; the console's sidebar guard does the same), so no entry inside it could reach a member without that power, whatever the entry's own gate said. The slot now gates nothing, as `group_configuration` already does, and a comment says that a contributor into it gates its own entry.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts` — Sessions (`nav_sessions`) and Notification Events (`nav_notifications`) carry the `manage_platform_settings` gate the group used to, so they reach exactly the members they reached before.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts` — the Audit Log entry (`nav_audit_logs`) is gated on `view_all_audit_log` (`LEDGER_AUDIT_CAPABILITY`), the ledger's own read capability. Platform administrators hold it by default (`ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES`).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, patch, with the `(narrowing)` arm, the BREAKING paragraph above and `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

Who is served what, by shipped permission set: `admin_full_access` holds both capabilities, so it still sees all three entries; `organization_admin` and the member sets hold neither, so they still see no Diagnostics group. A member granted `view_all_audit_log` alone now sees Diagnostics with Audit Log only. A custom set granting `manage_platform_settings` without `view_all_audit_log` no longer sees Audit Log (it still sees Sessions and Notification Events, and the page still opens by URL).

## Tests

- New `packages/cli/test/setup-diagnostics-audience.pin.test.ts` (unit tier): composes `SETUP_APP`, `SETUP_NAV_CONTRIBUTIONS` and `AuditPlugin`'s real contribution through the real `SchemaRegistry`, and reads `GET /api/v1/meta/apps/setup` through the real `RestServer` route per caller:
  - `view_all_audit_log` alone: Diagnostics is served with exactly `nav_audit_logs`;
  - `manage_platform_settings` alone: Diagnostics holds Sessions and Notification Events, and `nav_audit_logs` is served nowhere in Setup; `setup.access` alone: no Diagnostics group and no `nav_audit_logs` (with a control that the app itself is served);
  - the platform administrator (`ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES`): all three entries.
  It lives in `packages/cli/test/` because `cli` is the one package that depends on the shell, the plugin, the registry and the per-request filter; `@objectstack/plugin-audit` resolves to source there through the existing alias.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-nav-contribution.test.ts`: the entry-shape case now also asserts `requiredPermissions` equals `[LEDGER_AUDIT_CAPABILITY]`, and that the constant is `view_all_audit_log`.

## Acceptance notes

**The landing half, not done here.** For all three officer roles the Setup landing is Packaged Actions, which shows `activation ledger HTTP 403`. Measured cause: the console lands on the first entry the member is shown (`resolveLandingRoute` → `firstRouteAcross` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, over `navEntriesShownToMember` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts`). The first served Setup group for a member without `manage_platform_settings` is `group_apps`, whose one entry `nav_packaged_actions` (`type: 'component'`) carries no gate (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-packaged-actions-nav.test.ts`). The console's object-read prune judges `type: 'object'` entries only, so a component entry whose page reads `/data/sys_metadata_activation` is landed on even when that read answers 403. The seat ruled route A: give `nav_packaged_actions` an audience (`visible: "current_user.can('sys_metadata_activation', 'read')"`), reword the pin's reason, and pin where an officer lands instead. It follows in its own PR on #33224.

**Contributors into `group_diagnostics`.** The slot no longer gates what is put in it. Every contributor in this tree is gated now (the three entries above), and no contributor exists in the HotCRM checkout. A third-party package that relied on the slot's gate now shows its entry to every `setup.access` holder; the BREAKING paragraph says so.

## Verification

Code head: `136a7b67`; `63d6af9d` changes only the changeset text (the `(narrowing)` arm, BREAKING paragraph and ADR-0087 marker; `check-adr-0087-registration` reads it as `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`). Build closure: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/rest... --filter=@objectstack/plugin-audit... --filter=@objectstack/platform-objects...` (31 tasks, exit 0). The full dogfood battery owed by the `(narrowing)` arm runs on the final head and is reported in a comment.

<details><summary>New pin and ablations</summary>

- `test/setup-diagnostics-audience.pin.test.ts`: 3/3 passed.
- Ablation 1, the group gate put back (`setup.app.ts`, `group_diagnostics` given `requiredPermissions: ['manage_platform_settings']`; `platform-objects` resolves to `dist/` in this suite, so it was rebuilt and `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 built files): the auditor case went red (1 failed, 2 passed). Restored (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean: 3/3 passed. The first try of this ablation was a no-op (its replacement contained its own anchor, which `ablation-replace` refused and restored); its green run is void and was not counted.
- Ablation 2, the entry gate removed (`audit-plugin.ts`, aliased to source in this suite): the "without `view_all_audit_log`" case went red (1 failed, 2 passed). Restored (blob equal to HEAD, `git status --porcelain` empty): 3/3 passed.

</details>

Same run: `console-page-nav-entries.pin.test.ts` and `vitest-tiers-partition.test.ts` passed; `setup-integrations-order.pin.test.ts` could not load (`@objectstack/cloud-connection` has no build in this worktree), NOT MEASURED locally.
